description: This file defines the LocaleProjectStorage class, which implements storage and retrieval of locale project data using a key-value store in Drupal.

classes.name: LocaleProjectStorage
classes.description: Implements storage for locale project data using a key-value store, with caching and sorting functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the storage with a key-value store obtained from the factory.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, with optional default.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values for given keys, utilizing cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specific key.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Sets multiple key-value pairs and updates cache.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Resets internal cache and sorting flags.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the key-value store and resets cache.

methods.name: disableAll
methods.description: Disables all projects by setting their status to 0.

methods.name: countProjects
methods.description: Returns the count of all projects.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all projects, with sorting and caching.
